title: Cash Pickup Service Terms: Collection Window of a Shortfall Re-issue
content:
**Clause.** A re-issue of a shortfall on a Cash Pickup transfer is given the full pickup window of the transfer's tier, in whole calendar days counted from the day of the re-issue. Its last day of collection is the re-issue day plus that window.

## Reading the clause

- **Window length.** The window is the transfer's own tier's pickup window, as listed for that tier in the Cash Pickup tier schedule.
- **Counting.** Days are whole calendar days, and the count starts from the day of the re-issue.
- **Result.** The last day of collection is the re-issue day plus the window. The recipient may collect on that last day.

## Worked dates (hypothetical tier windows)

| Tier window (hypothetical) | Re-issue day | Last day of collection |
|---|---|---|
| 30 days | 10 June | 10 July |
| 15 days | 20 June | 5 July |
| 45 days | 1 March | 15 April |
| 7 days | 28 February (non-leap year) | 7 March |

In each row the window is the full tier window, counted from the re-issue day. The number of calendar days in the re-issue's window is the tier window itself, as a whole number of days.
